ranking_note: Supersedes eval-0b01, which broke the evidence rules: claim-0a01 has no backing snapshot and describes a method rather than quoting its source (superseded by claim-0a05), claim-0a03 derives only from it (superseded by claim-0a06), and technical_risk and asset_cost were marked derived with no evidence. Every dimension resting on them is now a hypothesis at half weight. Arithmetic: aggregate = sum(weight x normalized) / sum(weight) over the effective weights = 0.703; evidence coverage = non-hypothesis weight / total weight = 0.246, below the model's 0.60 min_coverage. (eval-0b01 recorded 0.643; the same arithmetic over its own weights gives 0.68.) Only platform_fit (claim-0a02) and time_to_market remain evidenced. The kill decision already recorded at G4 is unaffected; this records what the evidence actually supported.
